policy: Owner C1: retain, replace, or retire tools from real same-task evidence; preserve uncertainty when evidence is insufficient.

comparison_design.same_permission_class: one explicitly permitted public read-only query per provider; no secret or billing

findings: Both adapters completed the same public query with HTTP 200 at the same recorded UTC timestamp and returned five metadata rows.
For this single query, PubMed reported 24603 hits and Europe PMC reported 32604 hits; these provider-specific counts do not measure comparative recall or query quality.
The top-five result lists shared 0 exact PMID values. This is one ranked snapshot and does not establish that either provider is more relevant, complete, or accurate.
PubMed ESearch/ESummary is specialized for PubMed source requests and PubMed field-tag syntax; Europe PMC remains useful as a separate provider and may include other source identifiers.
No measured runtime, human review time, monetary cost, provider reliability, relevance precision, or false-negative rate was collected.

disposition.reason: The matched snapshot does not establish superiority or full coverage. Preserve both source adapters with distinct provider scopes; route only when the task explicitly needs PubMed or Europe PMC.
